meta.title: Automatic Car Wash Machines & Commercial Equipment
meta.description: Automatic car wash machines and commercial car wash equipment engineered for performance, durability, and scalable operations.

hero.title: Automatic Car Wash Machines Built for Every Facility
hero.intro: From compact rollover units to high-throughput tunnel systems, every WashThru machine is manufactured in Saudi Arabia and engineered to keep your business running.
hero.imageAlt: Illustration of the WashThru automatic car wash machine lineup

products.heading: Choose Your System
products.subheading: Two automatic wash platforms, each built for a different facility size and throughput target.

items.name: Rollover Machine
items.tagline: Compact automatic wash for limited-size facilities
items.description: We have designed the Rollover Machine to serve facilities of limited sizes. Thanks to its unique and natural factor-resistant design, this product has the ability to be placed outdoors without affecting performance or quality.
items.imageAlt: Illustration of the WashThru Rollover automatic car wash machine

items.name: Tunnel Machine
items.tagline: High-throughput wash for medium and large facilities
items.description: We have designed the Tunnel Machine to serve large and medium facilities, as it can wash vehicles sequentially without interruption.
items.imageAlt: Illustration of the WashThru Tunnel automatic car wash machine

highlights.heading: Built to the Same Standard
highlights.subheading: Whichever system fits your site, every WashThru machine shares the same manufacturing and support commitments.

items.title: Saudi Made
items.description: Every machine is designed and manufactured locally, so parts, service, and expertise are always close by.

items.title: Higher Production Speed
items.description: Optimized wash sequences keep vehicles moving without compromising the quality of the finish.

items.title: Warranty on Parts
items.description: Every unit ships with a warranty on parts, backed by a nationwide service network.

cta.heading: Not sure which system fits your site?
cta.subheading: Tell us about your facility and our team will recommend the right machine for your throughput and space.
